<!-- Read the Development Workflow and Issue Standards before submitting:
https://github.com/ZenWang00/semantic-shared-control/wiki/Development-Workflow
https://github.com/ZenWang00/semantic-shared-control/wiki/Issue-Standards

Use an ordinary issue reference, for example Refs #123 within this repository or
Refs ZenWang00/semantic-shared-control#123 across repositories. Do not use automatic
issue-closing keywords: acceptance, review, and required human decisions precede
explicit issue closure and the board's Done transition.

Substantive changes require an issue. Pure spelling/formatting corrections and
the one-time governance initialization are issue exemptions; state the exemption.
-->

## Outcome and Changes

<!-- Explain the problem and resulting behavior, scope, and relevant interface or
document changes. For a partial stage, state its deliverable and remaining stages. -->

## Related Issue

<!-- Refs #<issue number>, or the applicable issue exemption and its reason. -->

## Verification and Evidence

<!-- Map results to acceptance criteria. Include commands/checks, environment,
commit or artifact versions, and evidence links. For cross-repository work, link
companion PRs and record both tested source revisions and shared package/contract
versions; distinguish component checks from combined integration evidence. Distinguish simulation, replay,
and real-robot evidence. Use appropriate document checks for documentation;
do not add tests simply to mirror the implementation or for low-impact edits.
If a check was not run, state that explicitly and explain the remaining limit. -->

## Review and Required Decisions

<!-- Link an independent agent's review of the final diff and verification evidence.
An AI review record is not a separate GitHub account's approval.
Link human confirmation when required for core contracts, coordinate systems or
units, control authority, stop/failure semantics, or research conclusions intended
for a thesis or external communication. If an applicable decision was previously
confirmed, reference it rather than requesting it again. Otherwise state why no
human decision is required under the workflow. -->

## Limitations and Handoff

<!-- Record known limits, blockers, remaining work, follow-up issues, and the next
step with required files. State None if appropriate. If the task outgrew a single
conversation's context budget, preserve progress and identify the self-contained
follow-up stages; do not weaken acceptance criteria or claim unfinished work Done. -->
